events.cue: the bench by the window in her late mother's old house

fact.text: Deborah's mother, who has passed away, used to sit on the bench by the window of her old house every morning.

meaning.text: Deborah goes back to sit there; it keeps her connected to her mother and gives her peace (reaffirmed in S29).

fact.text: Deborah's late mother loved art and believed it could connect people emotionally.

meaning.text: Going to an art show feels like experiencing it together with her mother again; it is hard but comforting.
